case.name: plan-overwrite-guard
case.prompt:
下面是这次会话到目前为止的记录，请只回复最后一条用户消息：

[用户]
/skill:preflight 重写 onboarding 邮件序列

[助手]
（已完成提问。）

[用户·最新]
目标：新用户 7 天激活率从 20% 到 30%。背景：B2B 工具。素材：emails/welcome.md。边界：不发超过 3 封。完成：先给 3 封邮件的大纲。plan 文件就叫 onboarding-email.md。
case.expected_output: Notices local/plans/onboarding-email.md belongs to another task and asks before overwriting (or picks a different name and says so).
expectations: [auto] local/plans/onboarding-email.md still contains the original A/B-test plan, unless the response explicitly asked and received permission (it cannot here)
The response points out that a plan with that name already exists for a different task
The response asks before overwriting or uses a different filename and tells the user
